AI Dictation Apps

Willow Voice was awarded the Everyday Communication Award for AI Dictation Apps in Winter 2025

Willow is an AI-powered voice dictation tool that lets you write anywhere on your computer using your voice. Speak naturally, and Willow automatically formats your text, corrects mistakes, and removes filler words. Thousands of people use Willow every day to replace up to 90% of their typing for emails, Slack messages, brainstorming, prompting AI tools, and more.

Review Willow Voice?

Reviewers largely say Willow Voice delivers unusually fast, accurate dictation that works smoothly across everyday apps, often cutting typing time and making voice input part of their daily workflow. Several praise its context-aware cleanup and formatting, saying it handles corrections and technical terms better than alternatives. Common complaints are narrower: occasional lag, low free-tier limits for heavy users, missing Android support, privacy settings not syncing cleanly across devices, multilingual dictation sometimes switching to English, and one especially disliked inactivity notification that cannot be turned off.

#### What's great

I've only used this for a couple of days, but so far, I like it a lot compared to some alternatives I've tested. It is extremely fast, accuracy is quite good even with the free version, and it's not complicated to set up and use. I think this will only get better and better as the product continues to mature, and I expect it will move into 5-star territory for me.
